mapper.select: SELECT F.FILE_ID AS FILE_ID , F.STORAGE_PATH AS STORAGE_PATH , F.STORED_NAME AS STORED_NAME , FP.STORAGE_PATH AS PREVIEW_STORAGE_PATH , FP.STORED_NAME AS PREVIEW_STORED_NAME FROM NAS_FILE F LEFT JOIN NAS_FILE_PREVIEW FP ON FP.FILE_ID = F.FILE_ID WHERE F.DELETE_YN = 'Y' AND CURRENT_DATE - F.DELETED_AT::date >= #{retentionDays} ORDER BY F.DELETED_AT ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NAS_FOLDER F WHERE F.DELETE_YN = 'Y' AND CURRENT_DATE - F.DELETED_AT::date >= #{retentionDays} AND F.FOLDER_ID <> F.PARENT_FOLDER_ID AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NAS_FILE NF WHERE NF.FOLDER_ID = F.FOLDER_ID ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NAS_FOLDER CHILD WHERE CHILD.PARENT_FOLDER_ID = F.FOLDER_ID AND CHILD.FOLDER_ID <> F.FOLDER_ID )
